# 簡單快捷欄

[![Modrinth 上的 Simple Hotbar](https://github.com/AmongstReality/amongstrealitys-badges/blob/main/compact/modrinth@2x.png?raw=true)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/simple-hotbar)
[![CurseForge 上的 Simple Hotbar](https://github.com/AmongstReality/amongstrealitys-badges/blob/main/compact/curseforge@2x.png?raw=true)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/simple-hotbar)
[![Patreon 上的 amongstrealinity](https://github.com/AmongstReality/amongstrealitys-badges/blob/main/compact/patreon@2x.png?raw=true)](https://www.patreon.com/c/AmongstReality)
[![Buy Me a Coffee 上的 amongstrealinity](https://github.com/AmongstReality/amongstrealitys-badges/blob/main/compact/bmc@2x.png?raw=true)](https://buymeacoffee.com/amongstreality)

這個資源包會改變你的快捷欄、愛心與護甲圖示的外觀，並讓連線圖示根據不同的延遲（Ping）變換顏色。
